chunks: As for whatever is in it from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh al-Barqī, I have transmitted it from my father and Muḥammad ibn Mūsā ibn al-Mutawakkil—may Allah be pleased with them both—from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn al-SaʿdĀbādī, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh al-Barqī.

key_terms.الْبَرْقِيِّ: A nisbah referring to al-Barqī, the narrator being identified in the chain.
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: A supplicatory honorific meaning: may Allah be pleased with both of them.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicating direct transmission by the compiler.
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِي: From my father; part of the compiler’s transmission route.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain of Shaykh al-Ṣadūq to Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh al-Barqī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh al-Barqī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission and preserving the source lineage of the hadith material.
